summary: Architectural plan for PASS 5.30: Solo Voluntary Game Over ('End Run & Keep Score') in pause menu. Enables players in a hurry to cleanly bank and finalize scores of 5+ to records and seeds without forcing accidental score loss or cheat-prone save-and-resume. Preserves 100% isolation for 2P/3P/4P Pass & Play, Inbound Duels, and Outbound Rival runs.
